design_concept: Bloomberg Terminal × modern AI lab × elite cybersecurity platform

headings.style: uppercase, tight letter-spacing (tracking-tight), high visual dominance

metadata.style: used for timestamps, metrics, code diffs, logs, small labels, tabular-nums

visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle #B7FF00 green glow only on active/important interactive states. Avoid neon overload.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin technical grid lines (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)). Use border-collapse for grid layouts.
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle grain/noise texture overlay on backgrounds to remove flat digital feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. For sticky nav or tooltips: backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 and thin inner border.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for main sections. Internal card padding p-6 or p-8.
layouts.grid: Bento Grids for data dashboards. Asymmetrical layouts for editorial/problem sections.

components.name: Navbar
components.guidelines: Fixed at top, z-50. Backdrop blur, borders. Logo left, navigation center, primary CTA right. Use data-testid on links.

components.name: Hero Section
components.guidelines: Massive H1 title. Visual: Orbiting AI agents (SVG circles/nodes) around a central 'Core', attack vectors hitting shield layers, live status labels (Mono font). Animated with Framer Motion.

components.name: Problem Section
components.guidelines: Asymmetrical layout. Large numbers/typography. Stark contrast between card background (#0D0F0D) and primary background.

components.name: Autonomous Loop Pipeline
components.description: CODE → UNDERSTAND → ATTACK → VERIFY → HEAL → PREDICT
components.guidelines: Clickable horizontal or vertical stepper. Clicking updates a connected information panel displaying technical metadata for that stage.

components.name: Digital Twin Split-Screen
components.guidelines: Split layout (1:1). Left side: Real-world app. Right side: Isolated twin with animated attack vectors (arrows, red/green dots, paths drawn using framer-motion SVG stroke animation).

components.name: Multi-Agent AI Constellation
components.guidelines: Network node diagram. Central core with 6 connected agents. Hovering over an agent expands a detail card with live stats.

components.name: Red Team vs Blue Team Feed
components.guidelines: Scrolling terminal-like list. Mono font. Red team events (ATTACK) vs Blue team events (DEFEND/PATCH). Use counters at the top.

components.name: Self-Healing Diff
components.guidelines: Columns: Vulnerability | AI Patch | Validation. Show realistic code diff (red highlights for removed, green for added). Pure CSS/HTML layout, no images.

components.name: Security Intelligence Dashboard
components.guidelines: Use Recharts for a trend chart and attack surface graph. Include security score (massive text), vuln counts, agent activity, risk distribution pie chart, and patch status.

components.name: DevSecOps Pipeline
components.guidelines: Simulate a GitHub Pull Request interface showing the AI automatically reviewing code and merging a patch.

components.name: Technology Stack Grid
components.guidelines: Grid of `react-icons/si` (AWS, Docker, K8s, Python, etc.). Default color muted gray, hover color #B7FF00 with slight scale.

components.name: Final CTA
components.guidelines: High impact. Massive text. Primary lime button with magnetic hover effect.

components.name: Footer
components.guidelines: Simple links, technical aesthetic, mono font for copyright.

motion.guidelines: Smooth scrolling via Lenis. Scroll-triggered section reveals. Number counters for metrics. Animated SVG paths for attack vectors. Do not over-animate; prioritize premium clinical feel.

textures.description: Dust/noise texture for background. Set to low opacity (5%) with mix-blend-mode overlay to achieve the subtle grain texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium Javascript/React frontend. NO Typescript (.tsx). Use standard .jsx or .js files.
Apply fonts globally in tailwind.config.js (fontFamily: { sans: ['Inter'], display: ['Space Grotesk'], mono: ['JetBrains Mono'] }).
Implement the 'Security Core' hero with Framer Motion, utilizing rotating `<motion.div>` rings and nodes.
For the Tech Stack grid, import icons from `react-icons/si` and `react-icons/fa` instead of images.
Implement Recharts with custom tooltips and #B7FF00 stroke colors for the dashboard section.
Ensure the entire app is fully responsive (mobile, tablet, desktop) using Tailwind classes.
Create realistic code diffs using styled `pre` and `code` tags with `JetBrains Mono`.
Add `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, pipeline stages, nav items, dashboard tabs, etc.).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT center align the app container. No generic `.App { text-align: center; }`.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for navbars, dropdowns, or elements that overlap content.
Avoid generic AI illustrations (brains, matrix rain). Keep it strictly 'Bloomberg Terminal x AI Lab' (technical, data-heavy, precise, clinical).
Use layered z-indexes and 1px borders to create depth, avoiding thick shadows.
Only use the electric lime (#B7FF00) for highly interactive items, primary buttons, or critical data points. Do NOT overuse it as a background.
